label: Nothing is the efficient cause of itself, in any respect, from no self mover
meaning: Per-sense result for the moving branch of 'cause': Aristotle's reading that whatever moves something is other than it, with the open bridge that a self-efficient cause would move itself, gives that nothing is its own efficient cause.

strong_version_needed.2ed50036-3aa7-5209-9aa0-ced7675701da: The weak version STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT excludes self-moving only in a respect in which the thing is being moved; a self-efficient cause need not be being moved in that respect, so the bridge to self-moving does not reach a premise of the weak version.
